title: SWF: Compressed SWF output (CWS zlib)
description: Add zlib compression option to the SWF compiler. When CompileOptions.compress=true, compress the SWF body (everything after the 8-byte header) with zlib/deflate and change the signature from FWS to CWS. Use fflate's deflateSync. Tests: compile with compress=true → first 3 bytes are CWS, decompress body → valid SWF content, compress=false → FWS unchanged.
